questions.q: 想表達「我漸漸習慣一個人住」，哪一句正確？
opts: I'm getting used to living alone.
I'm getting used to live alone.
I used to living alone.
I'm used for living alone.
questions.exp: get used to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接動名詞 living；used to＋原形則是「過去常做」。

questions.q: 結帳時想說「這次我請客」，哪一句最自然？
opts: This one's on me.
This one's for me.
This one's by me.
This one's at me.
questions.exp: on＋人表示費用算那個人的，This one's on me. 就是「我請客」。

questions.q: 哪一句正確使用 dawn on？
opts: It finally dawned on me that I was wrong.
I finally dawned on it that I was wrong.
It finally dawned to me that I was wrong.
I was finally dawned by it.
questions.exp: dawn on 把「被明白的事」當主詞，領悟的人放在介系詞 on 後面。

questions.q: 哪個片語表示「向某人求助、尋求支持」？
opts: turn to someone
fall into someone
bleed into someone
get someone through
questions.exp: turn to someone 是向某人求助；get someone through 是「幫某人撐過」，方向相反。

questions.q: 想表達「我以前常戴這條項鍊（現在不戴了）」，哪一句正確？
opts: I used to wear this necklace.
I was used to wear this necklace.
I used to wearing this necklace.
I got used to wear this necklace.
questions.exp: used to＋原形動詞表示過去的習慣；be／get used to 後面要接名詞或 V-ing。

questions.q: 「失去理智、瘋了」的固定片語是哪一個？
opts: out of one's mind
out one's mind
out of one's depth
off the top of one's head
questions.exp: 固定說法是 out of one's mind，of 不能省；out of one's depth 是「超出能力所及」、off the top of one's head 是「不假思索地」，都是真片語但意思不同。

questions.q: 同事說 The pay at that company is peanuts. 意思是？
opts: 那間公司薪水少得可憐
那間公司供應花生點心
那間公司的東西沒有價值
那間公司規模很小
questions.exp: peanuts 在口語裡特指少得可憐的錢，最常用來講薪水或報酬。

questions.q: 朋友問你要不要換掉舊手機，你說 It still works, so I'll keep it for now. 這裡 for now 的意思是？
opts: 目前、暫時（之後可能會換）
從現在起永遠
就在此刻、立即
為了現在的需要付出代價
questions.exp: for now 是「暫時如此」，暗示之後可能改變，不是單純的「現在」。
